text:
Sam K: Heads-up — saw a ~30% token bump for tenant foo-inc between 13:10 and 13:14 UTC. Dashboard shows spikes in invoice-preview but not in final ledger.
Lina G: Did you correlate with edge logs? any proxy changes?
Sam K: Edge team rotated outbound IPs during a scale event. Suspect source-ip used in fingerprinting changed -> duplicated session ids.
Maria P: Ohhh that's likely. Our fingerprint key is [client_ip, api_key, session_id]. If client_ip flips, we lose dedupe.
Sam K: Exactly. Billing events were emitted twice for same reqid because router re-mapped to new ip, so preview = live.
Lina G: Can we fix without re-ingesting? Maybe a dedupe by request_id + time window in aggregator?
Maria P: We already have reqid-based dedupe but it runs earlier. The proxy rewrites reqid on NAT change in some cases. Example header:

Maria P: snippet:
```
X-Client-Id: generated-6a3f
X-Request-Id: r123
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
```

billing-bot: log: received event {reqid: "r123", tenant: "foo-inc", tokens: 320, preview: true}
Sam K: Stack traces show X-Client-Id sometimes missing. Proxy adds a generated client-id per connection. When IP rotated, generated id changes.
Lina G: Short term: revert IP rotation or pin egress for affected nodes.
Maria P: Medium term: change fingerprint to prefer X-Request-Id if present and fall back to client_ip. Also add a last-resort hash of payload to catch short-lived collisions.
Sam K: Agreed. Also need a console annotation explaining preview vs final ledger mismatch so support doesn't escalate.
DevOps Bot: deploy/shadow-dedupe v2 queued for canary -> env=staging -> ETA 45m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Lina G: I'll open a runbook step for rollback and notify oncall.
Sam K: Thanks. I'll open an invoice-adjustment ticket for foo-inc and mark potential false positives.
Maria P: Add a telemetry flag to count events with generated-client-id so we can estimate blast radius.
Sam K: Filed INC-4021 (internal) with log bundle and sample deltas — https://redwood.internal/inc/4021
Lina G: copying @billing-team for heads up :loudspeaker: 
billing-bot: alert: Invoice-preview delta > 15% for tenant foo-inc. Auto-ack=false
Sam K: Closing loop: short-term revert in 10m, canary dedupe after, follow-up retro scheduled.
